title: Dark Mode Design Tips That Actually Work 🌙
content: Dark mode is **not** just inverting colors. After spending months building my portfolio in dark mode here are the real lessons: 1) Never use pure black 2) Layered surfaces 3) Reduce text saturation 4) Adjust accent colors 5) Use glows not shadows 6) Test in actual darkness
